BookFast — Investor Pitch Deck
Synthetic test file for the MamakScore AI engine. Not a real company.
Contradictions are deliberate. See testdata_notes.md for the expected findings.

--- Slide 1: Title ---
BookFast
Salon booking, sorted.
Seed round — August 2026

--- Slide 2: The problem ---
Booking a salon appointment still means calling during business hours.
Salons lose bookings every evening and every weekend.
Independent salon owners spend up to 9 hours a week on the phone.

--- Slide 3: The solution ---
A booking app that lets customers book in under 30 seconds.
Salons get a calendar, automatic reminders and no more missed calls.

--- Slide 4: Traction ---
Over 5,000 salons are now on BookFast across Australia.
We have grown 8% month on month since February.
Our customers stay with us for an average of two and a half years.

--- Slide 5: Market ---
There are 25,000 salons in Australia.
The wider personal services market is worth $4.2 billion a year.

--- Slide 6: Business model ---
Every salon pays a flat $40 per month.
Gross margin is 85% after hosting and card fees.

--- Slide 7: Financials ---
We are currently generating $200,000 in monthly revenue.
Monthly burn is $11,000.
We have 30 months of runway at our current spend.

--- Slide 8: Unit economics ---
It costs us $220 to sign up a new salon.
Lifetime value per salon is $840.

--- Slide 9: The team ---
Two founders, both ex-salon owners, plus three engineers.

--- Slide 10: The ask ---
We are raising $500,000 to double the engineering team
and expand into New Zealand.
